title.en: Wire Harnesses and Cable Assemblies by Category
title.zh: 按大类选择线束与电缆组件

description.en: Start with the product family, application and interface requirement instead of searching through hundreds of individual part numbers. Drawings, samples, connector photos and pin definitions can all be used for project review.
description.zh: 不再从数百个具体料号中查找，而是先按产品大类、应用场景和接口需求选择。图纸、样品、接口照片或针脚定义都可以作为项目审核起点。

title.zh: 选择最接近需求的产品大类

description.en: The list is an engineering navigation aid, not a fixed stock catalogue. Final materials, construction, testing and compliance requirements are confirmed for each project.
description.zh: 以下分类用于工程需求导航，并非固定现货目录。最终材料、结构、测试与合规要求均按具体项目确认。

description.en: Built around the equipment layout, connector system, signal path and installation environment.
description.zh: 围绕设备布局、连接器系统、信号路径和安装环境定制。

description.en: Connectorized cable assemblies reviewed for signal, power, shielding, flexibility and environmental protection.
description.zh: 针对信号、供电、屏蔽、柔性和环境防护要求审核的连接电缆组件。

description.en: Vehicle, diagnostic and service harnesses defined by the exact platform, interface, pin route and operating task.
description.zh: 依据具体平台、接口、针脚路径和目标任务定义的车辆、诊断与维修线束。

zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束

title.zh: 连接器与品牌兼容系统

description.en: Connector-family selection and compatible sourcing reviewed by series, keying, terminal, seal and availability.
description.zh: 按系列、防错结构、端子、密封与供应情况审核连接器家族和兼容选型。

description.en: Special constructions for compact routing, strain relief, shielding, waterproofing and molded protection.
description.zh: 面向紧凑布线、应力消除、屏蔽、防水和成型防护的特殊结构。

description.en: Wire and cable construction selected around current, signal, motion, temperature, chemical and regulatory needs.
description.zh: 围绕电流、信号、运动、温度、化学环境与法规要求选择电线电缆结构。

intro.en: This custom harness type is defined around the target equipment rather than a fixed model. Connector selection, pin routing, wire structure, protection and installation details are confirmed before sampling.
intro.zh: 这一类定制线束围绕目标设备定义，并非固定型号。打样前需要确认连接器、针脚路径、线材结构、防护方式和安装细节。

zh: 连接器照片与插合信息

en: Wire gauge, length and branch structure

intro.en: This cable assembly type is selected by the two interfaces, electrical function, cable construction and environmental protection. Similar connector shells may still require different pin routes, shielding or molding.
intro.zh: 这一类电缆组件需要根据两端接口、电气功能、线缆结构和环境防护进行选型。即使连接器外形相似，针脚路径、屏蔽或注塑结构也可能不同。

en: Required signal, power or communication function
zh: 所需信号、供电或通信功能
注塑或尾壳工艺可行性

intro.en: This automotive or transportation harness type must be matched to the exact vehicle, equipment, tool or controller. Connector shape alone cannot prove pinout, protocol, power routing or functional compatibility.
intro.zh: 这一类汽车或交通线束必须与准确车型、设备、工具或控制器匹配。仅凭接口外形不能确认针脚、协议、供电路径或功能兼容性。

en: Vehicle, engine, controller or tool model
Model year, generation and target task
Both connector faces and current sample
Pin map, protocol and power requirement
zh: 车型、发动机、控制器或设备型号
两端接口正面和现有样品
针脚图、协议与供电要求

en: Heat, vibration, oil and abrasion exposure
Functional checks agreed for the project
zh: 温度、振动、油液与磨损环境

intro.en: This connector-system type is reviewed by family, series, keying, terminal, seal and mating requirement. Brand names describe compatibility targets and do not imply authorization or universal interchangeability.
intro.zh: 这一类连接器系统需要按家族、系列、防错结构、端子、密封件和插合要求审核。品牌名称仅用于描述兼容目标，不代表授权或可以无条件互换。

en: Connector brand, family or known part number
Terminal count, wire gauge and seals
zh: 连接器品牌、系列或已知料号
清晰插合面和侧面照片
端子数量、线径与密封件
原厂件或兼容来源偏好
供应情况与允许替代范围

intro.en: This specialty assembly or molding type is used when standard construction cannot meet space, movement, shielding, waterproofing, temperature or strain-relief requirements. Tooling and validation are reviewed before quotation.
intro.zh: 当标准结构无法满足空间、运动、屏蔽、防水、温度或应力防护要求时，可审核这一类特种组件或注塑结构。报价前需要确认工装和验证方案。

en: Target geometry and available installation space
zh: 目标几何结构与安装空间
线缆和连接器尺寸参考

intro.en: This wire or cable type is selected as part of the complete assembly specification. Current, voltage, signal, movement, temperature, chemical exposure and applicable standards determine the construction.
intro.zh: 这一类电线电缆属于完整组件规格的一部分。电流、电压、信号、运动、温度、化学环境和适用标准共同决定线缆结构。

zh: 弯折、拖链或固定安装方式

title.en: Select by Requirement, Not by Part Number
title.zh: 按需求选择，而不是按料号查找

description.en: A product family page should help a buyer understand the construction, application, customization inputs, risks and delivery path. Individual models remain internal references for matching samples and quotations.
description.zh: 产品大类用于帮助采购方理解结构、应用、定制资料、风险点和交付路径；具体型号仅作为样品匹配与报价时的内部参考。

text.en: Understand what the assembly connects, which functions it carries and where it is normally used.
text.zh: 说明组件连接什么、承载哪些功能以及通常用于哪些场景。

text.en: Explain connector, conductor, shielding, protection and routing choices in plain purchasing language.
text.zh: 用采购人员容易理解的方式说明连接器、导体、屏蔽、防护与布线路径。

text.en: Identify the information that prevents an incorrect fit, pin route, material or testing assumption.
text.zh: 明确哪些资料能够避免接口、针脚、材料或测试要求判断错误。

text.en: Show how the requirement moves through engineering review, material confirmation, sampling, inspection and shipment review.
text.zh: 说明需求如何经过工程审核、物料确认、打样、检验和出货复核。

title.zh: 从需求确认到稳定生产

text.en: Drawing, sample, connector photos, pin definition, target equipment and quantity range.
text.zh: 提供图纸、样品、接口照片、针脚定义、目标设备和数量范围。

text.en: Review interfaces, wire structure, materials, process feasibility and inspection points.
text.zh: 审核接口、线材结构、物料、工艺可行性与检验项目。

text.en: Build and confirm the sample against the agreed drawing, function and appearance requirements.
text.zh: 依据确认的图纸、功能和外观要求制作并确认样品。

text.en: Incoming inspection, crimping, assembly, continuity checks, identification, packing and shipment review.
text.zh: 执行来料检验、压接、组装、导通检查、标识、包装与出货复核。

title.en: Special Industries Are Reviewed Project by Project
title.zh: 特殊行业需求按项目逐项审核

text.en: Medical, military-spec, high-voltage, aerospace, RF, overmolded and other specialized requirements can enter capability review. Materials, standards, validation methods, tooling and compliance documents must be defined before quotation; a category name does not claim an existing certification or universal qualification.
text.zh: 医疗、军规、高压、航空航天、RF、注塑包胶等特殊需求可以进入能力审核。报价前必须明确材料、适用标准、验证方法、工装与合规文件；页面出现某个类别不等同于宣称已经持有相应认证或适用于所有项目。

title.en: Send the Requirement You Already Have
title.zh: 把现有需求资料发给我们

text.en: A complete drawing is helpful but not mandatory. A sample, interface photo or pin definition can also start the review.
text.zh: 完整图纸最有帮助，但不是唯一方式；样品、接口照片或针脚定义也可以开始审核。
